subject.title: fix(cron): honor AbortSignal in waitForActiveCronTaskRuns poll

question: Which gateway lifecycle event owns a signal that may cancel an in-progress cron task-drain wait when a restart is superseded or coalesced?
rationale: The current gateway path has only a fixed wall-clock deadline; selecting a distinct cancellation owner changes restart lifecycle semantics and cannot be safely inferred from the helper implementation.

options.title: Define and thread a restart-coalescing signal
options.body: Choose the restart owner and pass its abort signal to the drain helper, with focused lifecycle proof that a superseding restart exits before the ordinary deadline.

options.title: Defer cancellation support
options.body: Keep the existing deadline-only production behavior and remove this new signal API until the gateway lifecycle has an approved cancellation contract.

recommendation.title: Define and thread a restart-coalescing signal
recommendation.body: Choose the restart owner and pass its abort signal to the drain helper, with focused lifecycle proof that a superseding restart exits before the ordinary deadline.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership history could not be established from the available read-only environment; route to the cron/gateway lifecycle owner identified by repository history.
